items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: We was following Gonzalo White... He's a great little dancer too. He's a sensation drummer.

ctx.x: So we went to, after you left New Orleans, we went to Havana Cuba. And we stayed down there about four months. We was following Gonzalo White. I think that was his name. And that's when I, first, first time I remember seeing rasters, little rasters, little drummer rasters. Great sensation drummer. I was kind of fly there during that time of set, but I wasn't fly as he was. He used to make a running spin slide on his stomach and hit the bass drum and cymbal right on the beat. The band would be playing. Any time he…
Like you're knocking on the door.
